lines.zh: 每跳一下，我都黏在地上。
lines.en: Each hop, I stick to the ground.

lines.zh: 落地时身体摊开，又收回来。
lines.en: On landing I spread out, then draw back in.
Each hop carries me further than the last.

lines.zh: 我的身体在跳时拉成长条。
lines.en: My body stretches long as I leap.
I flatten the grass and leave a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我里面有什么在缓缓转动。
lines.en: Something inside me turns slowly.
Red threads rise to my surface.
I bounce over a stone.
I land with a wet sound.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往有动静的方向跳。
lines.en: I hop slowly toward the movement.
My body pulls out in thin strings.
I slide along the ground a stretch.
Each landing leaves me a little flatter.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，边缘还连着地。
lines.en: I leap, and my edges still cling to the ground.
I cross the grass and keep going.

lines.zh: 我留下的痕迹很快干掉。
lines.en: My trail dries quickly behind me.
I swell and contract in place.
What is inside shifts slowly.
I do not breathe; I only quiver.

lines.zh: 我的身体映出周围的颜色。
lines.en: My body takes on the colors around it.
I press to the ground. It is cool.
Red threads circle within me.
This lump of mine is made of flesh.
A small bubble rises on my surface.
I lean slowly to one side.
I spread a little wider.
My edge touches a fallen leaf.
I take it inside.
Your face shows on my surface.
I am only a lump of flesh.
I have no face, but I can feel.
I quiver at your feet.
I shift toward you.
What do you intend to do to me?
Touch me and you will be hurt.
I see you quite clearly.
I am about to hop. You had better move.
I hold a great deal inside me.
A piece was knocked out of me.
My body wobbles badly.
A few red threads snapped.
I retreat a pool's width.
I slowly pull myself together.
Part of me is left on the ground.
I quiver but do not come apart.
You crushed my edge.
I swell back into shape.
The wound closes; I bounce up again.
What is that in your hand?
I find things by smell.
I ooze over bit by bit.

lines.zh: 那东西在我身边会化掉。
lines.en: That will dissolve beside me.
This meat I'll digest slowly.
Do not put your hand past my edge.
I swallow very slowly.
This will not fill much of me.
Stand back; I am about to swell.
It floats inside me.
You hit something wet and soft.
I spread out under the pressure.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴着你的靴子。
lines.en: My body clings to your boots.
One bounce of flesh and you were gone.
A thread of cloth stuck to me.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我分出一小块。
lines.en: That separated a small piece of me.
I slowly gather myself back.
The ground is smeared wet.
We bounce a little apart.
You stepped over my edge.
My edge clings to your sole.
You step down and I slip a stretch.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我的形状歪了。
lines.en: That bent my shape out of line.
One touch, and I cling to you.
I pinch off a small piece of myself.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，就成一个。
lines.en: Pressed together, we become one.
You need not stay long.
I roll along after you.
We hold this path.
I leave a little of me at the corner.
You go first; I cover the back.
Together we have more weight.
Do not cut me apart.
We share the watch of this ground.
It sinks in and slowly dissolves.
It sinks slowly inside me.
Hard things will not go down. I push it out.
I carry it inside me as I move.

lines.zh: 这东西把我的颜色染深了。
lines.en: This has deepened my color.
I cannot tell its edge from mine.
It cut me slightly.
I push it to your feet.
I kept a little of it inside.
I hop and press it under me.
I hop toward you.

lines.zh: 你进了我能碰到的地方。
lines.en: You are within my reach.
Low to the ground, ready to hop.
I can only hop so far at a time.
You retreat, and I hop after.
Touching you is enough.
There is a wet patch under your feet.
I swell and gather for a jump.
I gather myself to spring.

lines.zh: 你的护甲没有缝，可缝在别处。
lines.en: Your armor has no gap — but the gaps are elsewhere.
I hop along with your steps.
Each hop makes my flesh quiver.
My surface is trembling.
I wait for the ground to dry a little.
You have stepped in my trail.
I have risen a little.
Your heels have no armor.
I cannot hop very far in one go.
I shift slowly to the side.
One more landing, then.

lines.zh: 血肉做的身体，一跳就摊开。
lines.en: Flesh body; one hop and I spread.

lines.zh: 我的身体贴在你的腿上。
lines.en: My body clings to your leg.
You were stuck for an instant.
Red threads coil around your wrist.
That knocked you away.

lines.zh: 我裂开了一块，又粘回去。
lines.en: I split a piece off and pull it back.
I slam into you, flecks flying.
I press in again.
Your kick scattered half of me.
My gel slowly gathers back.
I bulge up out of the ground.

lines.zh: 一滩肉在地上慢慢成形。
lines.en: A pool of flesh slowly takes shape.
First I spread out, then I rise.
The red threads on me are moving.
A patch of ground has gone wet.
I well up out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我涨到一人高，又落回去。
lines.en: I swell to a man's height and sink back.
There is a smell here.
I bounce twice on the spot.

lines.zh: 我的身体表面反了一下光。
lines.en: A gleam runs across my surface.
My surface shrinks from the heat.

lines.zh: 落地时我摊开，又慢慢聚起。
lines.en: I splatter on landing, then slowly gather.

lines.zh: 水把我冲淡了，我散在有水的地方。
lines.en: Water thins me; I spread through it.
The blast shatters me into several pieces.

lines.zh: 有东西穿进了我的身体里。
lines.en: Something has punched into my body.

lines.zh: 一股怪力让我的红丝全僵住。
lines.en: A strange force stiffens all my threads.
I am empty and growing thinner.

lines.zh: 电穿过我，血肉都缩紧了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me; my flesh clenches.

lines.zh: 我一直在往下掉，散开了。
lines.en: I keep falling, and I come apart.
